description: Save a DRAFT reply to a message in YOUR Outlook mailbox, in the same conversation. Never sends. Previews first; saves only on a second call with confirm: true and the preview_id. Sign-in required.

body.description: Plain-text reply. The quoted original is added by Outlook.

confirm.description: true only on the second call, after the person agreed to the preview.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Same key on a retry replays instead of saving twice.

message_id.description: The message to reply to, from search_outlook_email or get_outlook_thread.

preview_id.description: preview_id from the preview call. Required with confirm: true.

reply_all.description: Reply to everyone on the message. Defaults to false.

name: draft_outlook_reply
title: Draft an Outlook reply
